message.text:
The frontend auth interceptor lives in `web/src/connect.ts`. It manages access tokens via Bearer headers and refresh tokens via cookies with credentials included.

Access tokens are JWTs stored in memory via auth-state. Refresh tokens are cookies consumed by the refreshToken RPC. Backend validation is handled by the `server/auth` package's Authenticator. Personal access tokens exist on the backend but are not managed by the frontend interceptor.

The frontend auth interceptor lives at `web/src/connect.ts` as `authInterceptor`. It manages a JWT access token sent via Bearer header and stored in localStorage, plus a JWT refresh token sent via cookie with `credentials: include`. The backend package that validates these tokens is `server/auth` (`Authenticator`).

q29.
web/src/connect.ts; JWT access token (Bearer) + refresh token (cookie); server/auth

`authInterceptor` in `connect.ts` attaches `Authorization: Bearer <access token>` (from `web/src/auth-state.ts`) and refreshes via `AuthService.RefreshToken` with `credentials: "include"`. The backend validates tokens in `server/auth` (`Authenticator`; also used by `AuthInterceptor` in `connect_interceptors.go`).
